description: This file defines a React component 'List' and a nested component 'ListItem' for rendering a list interface with contextual styling, validation, and flexible layout options. It also exports context and subcomponents for use in a React application.

methods.name: ListItem
methods.description: A React functional component representing an item within the list, supporting validation and layout options.

methods.name: List
methods.description: A React functional component representing the list container, providing context to its children.
